description_en: Reranks the results of vector retrieval and full-text retrieval to address inaccurate sorting by using semantic understanding to rescore and reorder recalled data, which significantly improves result relevance and accuracy. AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL allows you to invoke rerank models to reorder retrieval results, but does not provide the models
description_zh:
Rerank能够解决向量检索和全文检索结果排序不精准的问题，通过语义理解对召回数据重新打分排序，显著提升结果的相关性与准确性。
AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL版支持调用Rerank模型对检索结果做重排，但不提供模型
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb rerank --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: Rerank

The instance ID.

parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.example: ADBPG is an Alibaba Cloud OLAP database.
parameters.help_en: The list of documents to be reranked
parameters.help_zh: 要重新排序的文档列表
parameters.name: documents

parameters.help_en:
The rerank model. Valid values:
bge-reranker-v2-m3: provides good performance and supports up to 8,192 tokens for a single inference. Text that exceeds this limit is split into chunks, which may degrade performance. This is the default value.
bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise: provides better performance than bge-reranker-v2-m3 and supports up to 2,048 tokens for a single inference. Text that exceeds this limit is split into chunks, which may degrade performance
parameters.help_zh:
Rerank模型，目前支持
bge-reranker-v2-m3:（默认值），性能较好，单条推理支持8192tokens，超出会被切分，效果可能下降。
bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise：效果相比v2-m3更优，单条推理支持2048tokens，超出会被切分，效果可能下降
parameters.name: model

parameters.example: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
parameters.help_en: The description of the custom ranking task type. This parameter can be set when RerankModel.Name is qwen3-rerank. It guides the model to use different ranking strategies
parameters.help_zh:
当RerankModel.Name为qwen3-rerank时可设置。
添加自定义排序任务类型说明，通过该参数可以指导模型采用不同的排序策略
parameters.name: instruct

parameters.help_en: The number of most relevant documents to return
parameters.help_zh: 要返回的最相关文档的数量
parameters.name: topk

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the document text. If this parameter is set to false, the document text is not returned. Only the indexes and rerank scores of the sorted documents are returned
parameters.help_zh: 为false时，不返回Documents文本，仅仅返回文档排序的索引及rerank得分
parameters.name: return_documents

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of chunks allowed when the text exceeds the model window. Valid values:
bge-reranker-v2-m3: 10. This is the default value.
bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise: 5. This is the default value.

Chunking example
If you use the bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise model, the maximum single inference window is 2,048 tokens. If the query is 48 tokens and a single document parameter contains 9,000 tokens, the document is split into chunks: tokens 1 to 2,000 form the first chunk, tokens 2,001 to 4,000 form the second chunk, and so on. If the number of chunks exceeds the value of MaxChunksPerDoc, the subsequent text is discarded
parameters.help_zh:
超出模型窗口时，允许将文本切分的最大块数：
bge-reranker-v2-m3：默认值是10。
bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise：默认值是5：

切分举例
如果使用bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise模型，则最大单推理窗口为2048tokens，此时如果query是48tokens，单个document参数内容为9000tokens，则会被分为：1-2000为第一个，2001-4000为第二个，以此类推，并且切分个数超过MaxChunksPerDoc后，后面的语句会被丢弃
parameters.name: max_chunks_per_doc
